title: Finance and Growth: Simple and Compound Interest, Hire Purchase and Inflation
seo_title: Grade 10 Finance and Growth Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Use the simple and compound growth formulae A = P(1 + in) and A = P(1 + i)ⁿ to solve problems, including interest, hire purchase, inflation, population growth and other real-life problems; understand the implication of fluctuating foreign exchange rates.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 finance and growth worksheets: simple and compound interest, hire purchase, inflation, population growth and exchange rates. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Simple interest: A = P(1 + in). Compound interest: A = P(1 + i)ⁿ.
  • i is the rate as a decimal (8% = 0,08) and n is the number of years.
  • Hire purchase uses simple interest on the amount owed after the deposit.
  • Inflation and population growth use the compound formula.

Examples

Example

R5 000 at 8% p.a. compounded for 3 years

5 000 × 1,08³

Answer: R6 298,56

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Simple or compoundCompound: A = P(1 + i)ⁿ.
The exponentn is the number of years.
The rateDivide by the right rate.
